_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil with no breaker: funding, fear/greed, momentum and flows sit below active trigger levels, so score stays inside Disbelief band until a confirmed shift.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative neutral-factual on outflows without a phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds ~50-62, funding stays near flat, 30d momentum does not accelerate, phase score remains in Disbelief band
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding and fear/greed through ~70 with ETF flows turning up together (UP into Hope), or flush drops fear/greed under ~46 with exchange inflows spiking (DOWN into Complacency)
